regions.purpose: Reflects the candidate Location being added (display name or raw coordinates). Read-only confirmation that the user is still adding the right place; not editable here.

The user's Collections, browsable as a vertical list — the pick. Holds the New Collection affordance as the first row so creating a new Collection mid-flow is one tap away without leaving the sheet. Also holds the Back affordance for stepping back to LocationDraftSheet without dropping the candidate.

affordances.label: New Collection
affordances.note: Propagates return-to-draft-context. The candidate Location stays in the MapOverview host's UiState while the editor is on top; CollectionEditor's DONE_AS_DRAFT_RETURN pops back to MapOverview, commits the candidate against the just-created Collection, and surfaces the same post-add Snackbar as PICK_COLLECTION.

shows: Collection.appearance (color, pinStyle) as a visual marker
a pre-selected indicator when this Collection matches collection-context (addToCollection mode)

affordance.label: Pick this Collection
affordance.note: Commits the Entry and dismisses the sheet; the host carries the new Entry as pending-review-context and renders a Snackbar prompt to author the Review. See doc02.02.02.07.

lists.emptyState: When the user has no Collections, the region shows a hint pointing at New Collection. The candidate Location is held in the host's UiState; tapping New Collection enters CollectionEditor with return-to-draft-context, and DONE_AS_DRAFT_RETURN resumes the flow by committing the candidate against the just-created Collection.
